python3 - <<'PY'
import re
text=open('main.c').read()
# extract room string blobs
parts=re.findall(r'/\* Room.*?\*/\s*((?:"[^"]+"\s*)+),', text, re.S)
for i,p in enumerate(parts):
    s=''.join(re.findall(r'"([^"]+)"', p))
    print(f'room{i} len={len(s)} rows={len(s)//20}')
    for r in range(len(s)//20):
        row=s[r*20:(r+1)*20]
        if len(row)!=20: print(' bad', r, row)
    # find P D M B E
    for ch in 'PDBME':
        idx=[i for i,c in enumerate(s) if c==ch]
        print(f'  {ch}:', [(i%20,i//20) for i in idx])
PY
/opt/gbdk/bin/lcc -o game.gb main.c assets.c 2>&1
ls -la game.gb
